suites.notes: Adversarial transport cases cover raw valid JSON, fenced valid JSON, untagged fences, unsupported fence tags, fenced malformed JSON, prose before a fence, prose after a fence, two fenced blocks, nested fences, unterminated fences, two raw objects, a JSON array where an object is required, semantic-value preservation over a pretty-printed body, provenance retention, text profiles, and determinism under repetition. Escalation cases cover accepted-but-unqualified tiers, qualified tiers with clean output, normalization-triggered escalation, structurally accepted output that is not safe to stop, evidence-only risk, weak grounding, settled claims with no evidence, legitimately single-lineage support, vendor repetition only where independence was available, structural anomalies, repeat disagreement, 7B fails then 14B stops, 14B fails then 27B stops, accepted 14B never skipped, all tiers failing, and the assertion that no trigger fires on any fixture's reference answer. Runner cases cover authorization bound to the exact freeze digest and its rejection when the digest, the benchmark name or the confirmation string is wrong; a complete provider-free 216-call run with five-view terminal agreement at 216/217; rejection of resume after terminal; pause after four calls and exact resume with no duplicates; provider model mismatch stopping incomplete without retry; persistence of isolated coding evidence so scoring does not misjudge grounding; and the transport effect appearing as a gap between the raw and normalized matrices within one run.
repeat_disagreement is settled during scoring, once the repeats of a fixture and tier are known. Without that pass the trigger could never fire in a real run.
Counterfactual / prospective normalization diagnostic over all 216 frozen G-ROUTE1 raw records. Zero findings.

synthetic_full_run_exercise.notes: Reference answers with the 27B's observed fence habit injected. The 20-cell gap between the raw and normalized matrices is the transport effect the experiment isolates. The 24 fixture-repeats that never stop are the 18 evidence-only R4 units and the 6 conversation units above R1, exactly as the policy intends.
